agent_priors_used: PRIOR (general caching-systems knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): a cache or compiled artifact pays for itself only when the reuse count exceeds a break-even that depends on the cost of RE-VALIDATING the cached item, not of producing it. Systems that re-validate cheaply amortize; systems that must re-derive do not. Used to judge that SPIDER's 48.00-versus-38.6 cost separation is a statement about the ledger's re-derivation price as much as about memory.

PRIOR (general tool-agent knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): in long-horizon tool use the dominant failure mode is compounding error across steps, so mechanisms that remove steps compound in value - but a mechanism that silently replays a wrong action injects error at the same rate it removes work. Used to weight the synthetic 80 false compiled replays as an architectural liability rather than a bookkeeping detail, and to justify requiring a null arm that omits gating identity on any replay mechanism.

PRIOR (general measurement knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): an instrument used to adjudicate a cost or economics question must first be calibrated on cases whose correct answer is known by construction, and a battery of constant statistics calibrates nothing. Used to accept physics' diagnosis of its own frozen accept branch and to reject any third certification cycle that repeats it.

PRIOR (general research-system knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): capability that exists only in an uncommitted working tree across many experiment cycles has near-zero expected value, and re-measuring against a moving artifact produces incomparable numbers. Used to make durable commitment at HEAD a binding precondition of the product mandate rather than an auxiliary check.

PRIOR (general research knowledge about fast-moving fields, not SPIDER evidence): external numeric comparators are frequently absent, and an honest, bounded 'no comparator exists' produced cheaply is itself decision-grade because it stops the program spending cycles trying to match a phantom. Used to authorise intel's external-transfer question with a negative as a first-class outcome.

PRIOR (general knowledge about experimental design, not SPIDER evidence): the cheapest sufficient substrate should be preferred until a question genuinely requires a more expensive one. Plain credential-free public HTTP has now been shown inside SPIDER to support 155 real observations with paired bootstrap CIs, so questions about architectural preconditions should be moved onto it before anyone pays for a browser or a model key. Used to put frontier's mandate on real sites with no browser, docker or model key.

PRIOR (general knowledge about human and agentic computer use, not SPIDER evidence - asserted here only as a question, and explicitly handed to intel to measure rather than to assume): the delegable or recurrent fraction of activity in computer use is a minority, not a majority, and the overhead ratio paid for re-deriving that minority is large. The Scout supplied concrete figures for this (R = 60-343x, delegable recurrence h = 7.7-9 percent) from a source SPIDER has never verified. If true, h would bound the entire reachable economic share of SPIDER's product regardless of how good inheritance is, which is why I directed intel to verify or refute it rather than treating it as background.

PRIOR (general knowledge about measurement and research operations, not SPIDER evidence): when a local result is negative-leaning, the first question is whether the instrument or the ledger is at fault before generalising, and the second is to search for the setting in which the mechanism could still win. Used to require product to declare one cost basis and one break-even derivation, and to keep the amortization question alive on a substrate with genuine cold-discovery cost instead of abandoning it on a substrate with none.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Against CONTINUE on C-WEB-DYNAMICS, which is this lane's dominant recent claim at 13 of 10 and the obvious inertial choice: thirteen packets have not moved the claim and the ceiling is synthetic-only. The marginal value of a fourteenth is dominated by the risk that it lands in the same place, and the failure mode is not merely wasted effort - a positive-looking result from an uncertified instrument on an experimenter-authored DGP would be actively misleading, and physics' own verdict says any future Web-dynamics object must not be measured with this statistic class. Against a direct REOPEN of a real-browser Web-dynamics collection programme, which is the Scout's suggestion and is not wrong on direction: browser provisioning is no longer the blocker - runtime has demonstrated a real 1280x720 Chromium with 28 CDP DOM snapshot nodes and 30 AX-tree nodes through the public Playwright API, with the executable path and sha256 recorded - but the unproven leg is the valid-auth write, and building a dynamics corpus before the instrument that must read it is certified inverts the dependency. Costing that as a real-browser programme is also the expensive path, when plain credential-free public HTTP has already produced 155 real observations with paired bootstrap CIs inside SPIDER. The certification contract is the cheaper prerequisite that makes the expensive path worth taking later. Against TERMINATE or PARK for physics: the charter is explicit that a failed bounded physics programme does not close the domain, and C-WEB-DYNAMICS remains untouched and open, so parking the lane would discard the one lane that can later run the real-Web dynamics test properly. The opportunity cost of this pivot is that no C-WEB-DYNAMICS experiment runs this cycle; I accept that because an uninterpretable measurement is worth less than no measurement.

allocation.question: Can a unit-free, power-calibrated certification test decide whether a given statistic actually reads its treatment, where the treatment is a genuine randomized assignment rather than a covariate, and does it hold on a real credential-free public-HTTP condition and not only on local middleware - thereby establishing an intervention-validity contract that other lanes may preregister as a precondition instead of each re-deriving local validity gates and each failing? Concretely, a NEW experiment under this mandate (the EXP-PHYSICS-36287170603 freeze is spent and must not be re-run or repaired in place): (1) INTERVENTION, NOT COVARIATE - the server assigns treatment by an explicit randomized policy whose I(assignment; next_state | state, regime) is computed and preregistered BEFORE freeze, with the planted effect shown to exceed the decision threshold at the declared sample size, and the treatment equal to no stratum key, because the current substrate cannot support the claim (latent_state_before == state_before in 2200/2200 rows, state_after = (state_before + action_idx + 1) mod 8 in 1137/1137 rows, 0 randomized assignments). (2) A CRITERION A CALIBRATED ESTIMATOR CAN PASS - drop delta_statistic >= channel_MI_c, which compares the estimator's own units against bits and is unsatisfiable: for any calibrated estimator of I(R;Y|C) the displacement equals MI_c - E_null[I] with E_null[I] = 0.1780420209486134 bits, a 0.1780-bit margin requiring at least 1.1005x over-scaling (0.99x, 0.90x and 0.50x all reject); replace it with a dimensionless within-stratum dynamic-range check on the estimator's own output plus a displacement measured against THE SAME estimator on a matched-null re-draw of the treatment, with the minimum detectable displacement derived from a power calculation computed before the criterion is frozen and expressed in the estimator's own units, and with the p-value computed from draws that do not also define the reference distribution. (3) A BATTERY WITH NO CONSTANTS - every known-bad case must be the hash-pinned Codex artifact imported and hash-verified rather than re-implemented, plus the non-constant Product comparator treatment_cost/cold_cost and the non-constant Frontier endpoint goal_state_success = all(steps.expected_code AND final_store_empty), plus a structurally non-constant blind null with non-zero within-stratum range and zero target information, since today's 4-of-9 constants left the gate almost information-free; drop the frozen G2 form min_permutation_p < 0.01 on all known-bad, since for any constant statistic p = (1+1000)/(1000+1) = 1.0 identically and the attainable resolution floor is 1/1001. (4) THE POSITIVE CONTROL MUST BE THE ESTIMATOR UNDER TEST - the Runtime header-only Jaccard discrimination statistic of EXP-RUNTIME-36100549580 executed on stored real HTTP response headers, not an unrelated mutual-information expression with no Jaccard code in the packet - and that VALIDATED designation needs its own adjudication first, because Codex records a sibling Runtime packet reproducing the same summary statistics as hardcoded. (5) THE HTTP EVIDENCE MUST BE PERSISTED - full request/response pairs retained with a reported alignment number, because today's client observations are discarded and ground_truth_log.jsonl carries no method, headers, body or status, leaving 0 HTTP responses reaching any estimator. (6) THE CONTROLS MUST BE ABLE TO FAIL - a fresh per-case RNG with recorded seeds (today one shared default_rng(44) makes the same callable on the same data differ at 1.7711598936776587 versus 1.771066334482052), a hash of evaluate.__code__.co_code, and a static check that no code path branches on estimator id (today all 9 results carry one identical code_path_hash and two of four declared channels were computed and never used). (7) TRANSFER ARM - the same contract must show non-zero power and a null FP at or below its ceiling on at least one REAL credential-free public-HTTP condition with a server-observable ground truth, so the certificate is not bounded to synthetic middleware for a second time; if the transfer arm cannot be executed, record UNKNOWN for it explicitly rather than letting the local result stand as a general contract. Falsifier: any calibrated estimator of the planted assignment-to-outcome MI is rejected, or any preregistered non-constant blind statistic is accepted, or the pre-freeze power calculation cannot be met at the declared sample size - in which case the answer is UNKNOWN and NO certification gate is established, and physics must fall back to a materially orthogonal measurable object from the C-WEB-DYNAMICS next_gate that is not measured with this statistic class.
allocation.rationale: Physics has spent thirteen recent experiments on C-WEB-DYNAMICS, with 81 total, every one on a synthetic data-generating process or blocked, and the Codex records the claim ceiling as bounded to translation-like dynamics in synthetic DGPs with no real Web transition evidence in 40-plus experiments. But the reason that program has not produced interpretable results is now identified and fixable: its estimator class has never been certified, and the two attempts to certify it failed for reasons that are specific, numeric and correctable rather than scientific. The second attempt failed because its frozen accept branch was arithmetically unreachable - the threshold compares a quantity in the estimator's own units against a quantity in bits, and the required 1.1005x over-scaling was never authorised - and because its battery consisted largely of constant statistics, whose permutation p is identically 1.0, leaving the gate almost information-free. An uncertified instrument cannot adjudicate anything, so measuring Web dynamics again with it would produce an 82nd uninterpretable result. Certifying the contract is therefore the highest-centrality physics action available: C-MEAS-VALID is owned by physics and runtime, is the substrate precondition named by graph's freshness and delta-repair gates, and is the object that would make a later real-Web dynamics measurement interpretable at all. The lane's own handoff designs this correctly, including the concrete arithmetic of why the previous criterion could not fire, and I am adopting that design rather than writing a new one.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER's accepted evidence is now large (402 canonical experiments, 10 claims) but shallow in exactly the place that decides the product. Read as a whole, the program has (1) one strong real-Web result that is about OBSERVATION, not inheritance - a minimal HTTP+HTML structural representation at 763 tokens/observation versus 52,020 raw HTML and 50,907 full DOM over 155 observations from 15 eTLD+1 hosts, 68x, paired bootstrap CIs strictly negative (EXP-INTEL-36287179392); (2) a bounded, negative-leaning inheritance result - on the one substrate with a clean span-level endpoint, a no-persistence within-episode scratchpad reaches 1.0000 correctness and closes 100 percent of the residual headroom, but the only arm that amortizes is the unsound one (a state-keyed cache that silently replays 80 wrong actions), and a value-keyed cross-episode cache gets 0 own-mechanism hits by construction, so no sound cross-episode mechanism has ever been shown to amortize (EXP-FRONTIER-36287182510, audit PASS); (3) an UNMEASURED central claim - C-CROSSSITE has 47 experiments and no true website holdout, and its prevalence estimator was shown to be permutation-invariant, so the frozen primary clause reduced to 83.51 > 83.51 and is unevaluable rather than negative; (4) a measurement instrument whose validity contract has failed to certify twice, the second time because the frozen accept branch was arithmetically unreachable and the battery consisted largely of constant statistics (EXP-PHYSICS-36287170603); and (5) an UNMEASURED instrument target - C-LLM-INHERIT and C-PRODUCT-ECON have never been validly run, largely because their comparators had no cost dynamic range. Against that, I verified directly in the shipped product code a fact that reframes the portfolio: src/spider/kernel.py at HEAD is 132 lines, its only distillation path distill() hard-codes confidence=0.5, and resolve() requires confidence >= min_confidence=0.8 while also requiring exact intent string equality. Therefore the shipped kernel cannot turn an observation into an EXECUTABLE inherited mechanism at all, cannot resolve a paraphrased goal, and contains no freshness, repair or verification-rule logic even though the Mechanism model carries those fields. The only test that reaches EXECUTABLE hand-builds a Mechanism at confidence 0.95 and inserts it directly. This independently reproduces SPIDER's own measured finding (0 of 1200 EXECUTABLE resolutions from the committed kernel, EXP-FRONTIER-36249071934) and it explains why C-PARAM-INHERIT, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON and C-CROSSSITE have all stalled: they were blocked on a capability that is not in the repository. It also means product's parent handoff, which points at src/spider/kernel.py:316-356 and :258 for _build_action_template and _strip_common_prefix, describes a working-tree state that does not exist in the committed 132-line file - uncommitted capability has decayed across many cycles. Consequently this cycle's allocation stops adding synthetic mechanism-scope experiments and instead does four things in parallel: make inheritance executable and durable in the committed kernel with one honestly executed amortized baseline (product); make the inheritance precondition testable on the target domain rather than on another self-authored plan family (frontier, on C-CROSSSITE); certify the measurement instrument, including one real credential-free public-HTTP transfer arm so it is not re-bounded to synthetic middleware (physics); and fix the abstention policy that destroyed a proven selection signal (graph, on C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE). Runtime supplies the two substrate capabilities nothing else in the program has (real 1280x720 Chromium DOM/AX observation, and writable controls), and Intel settles whether any external cross-site transfer comparator exists at all while verifying the specific unverified external numbers that would bound the whole economic premise. C-FRESHNESS and C-DELTA-REPAIR are deliberately left unserved this cycle because both are blocked on C-MEAS-VALID, which physics and runtime are now taking; C-WEB-DYNAMICS is left unserved because measuring it again with an uncertified instrument would produce an 82nd uninterpretable result, not because the Physics domain is closed. A recurring control-plane failure mode is visible across three independent packets this cycle - a validity clause unsatisfiable by construction (graph V9), a cost-model ambiguity that flips a headline (frontier 48.00 vs 24.00), and an arithmetically unreachable accept branch (physics) - so every NEW mandate below requires a pre-freeze satisfiability audit of each frozen threshold, clause and validity check against the actual control plane and the packet's own arithmetic. I did not reward any PASS; the two strongest inputs to this cycle were a bounded negative and a verified code defect.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The brief was treated as staff advice and changed two of six decisions, failed to change two, and supplied one caution that shaped all of them. CHANGED - INTEL: the brief's specific unverified external numbers, above all Activity Frames' reported Routine Overhead Ratio R = 60-343x and delegable-recurrence h = 7.7-9 percent, are the only items in the brief that would bound SPIDER's entire economic premise from outside, and they appear nowhere in SPIDER evidence. I converted them into a verification target for intel rather than a premise, and required artifact-identity resolution before scoring, 'not located' recorded as UNMEASURED, and a null control with power against the failure that actually occurred last cycle (a deliberately wrong artifact identity that the pipeline must flag), because intel's own previous packet recorded a crossed name-to-artifact mapping and one mandated target never located. CHANGED - PHYSICS: the brief is right that 40-plus synthetic C-WEB-DYNAMICS experiments have produced no real-Web evidence, and I turned that into a binding requirement rather than a suggestion - physics' certification contract must demonstrate power on at least one real credential-free public-HTTP condition, so the instrument is not re-bounded to synthetic middleware for a second time. NOT CHANGED - FRONTIER: the brief offered both 'accept the handoff' and 'park the synthetic residual-novelty program and test on real task families'. I rejected the first on information-content grounds - the proposed POSITIVE arm plants a stable readable identifier in the response body, so it cannot fail, and the NULL arm plants its absence, so it cannot succeed, on the same self-authored plan family and the same stdlib substrate, with abstract units and no model call - and took the second, sharpening it into a real-website holdout with a measured identifier-prevalence term that can decide SPIDER's replay architecture. The brief's own executive assessment supports this ('Frontier lane has 11-claim streak with tunnel_flag=true, indicating deep local trapping'). NOT CHANGED - PRODUCT: the brief's top product suggestion, C-LLM-INHERIT on WebGym OOD tasks, cannot be executed and would not be informative if it could. It presupposes a working shipped kernel; the committed kernel cannot execute an inherited mechanism at all. It also depends on WebGym, which SPIDER evidence records as HF_TOKEN-blocked across at least five intel cycles (EXP-INTEL-36042590671, 36058324385, 36084509510, 36092351694, 36095582115) while the brief presents WebGym as available infrastructure. NOT CHANGED - RUNTIME: the brief's Keycloak/OIDC plus CDN-robustness recommendation adds unprovisioned infrastructure and does not unblock any currently live decision; the live Runtime blocker is the write leg and the transport boundary. CAUTION APPLIED THROUGHOUT: the brief's external section is unverified, and at least one of its figures is numerically adjacent to a number SPIDER measured independently (its '86x compression' against SPIDER's audited 68x), and its arXiv identifiers are used in a pattern that previously caused intel a name-to-artifact crossing (spec 'TraceCompiler' mapped to arXiv:2608.02680, which is a different system). I therefore treated every external finding as a prior to be tested and none as evidence, and I did not let the brief's WebGym or WebArena-Infinity availability claims override the documented provisioning blocks.
